main.title: Nintendo Museum
main.subtitle: Nintendo's history, on display
main.summary: The Nintendo Museum is a video game museum located in Uji, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan.

cards.heading: A museum in Uji
cards.text:
The Nintendo Museum is a video game museum located in Uji, Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. It is owned by the video game company Nintendo and displays a wide variety of products from across the company's history. The museum opened on October 2, 2024.

The Nintendo Museum was first announced in 2021. It sits on the site of the old Ogura Plant, where Nintendo used to make trading cards as well as repairing toys and consoles. It features a new gallery that "showcase[s] the many products Nintendo has launched over its history" while focusing on the company's "product development history and philosophy with the public" dating back to its origins. Construction of the Nintendo Museum was completed in May 2024, and it opened five months later on October 2.

cards.heading: Playing at a different scale
cards.text: Alongside the museum exhibit, which takes up the entire second floor of the building, the Nintendo Museum features a number of interactive experiences based upon various toys previously produced by the company including the Ultra Hand, Ultra Machine, Love Tester, Game & Watch and NES Zapper. Additionally, visitors can play a variety of classic video games on home consoles up until the Nintendo 64 or complete certain challenges in games using gigantic controllers which require two players to operate.

cards.heading: Making Hanafuda
cards.text: The museum also offers a workshop for an additional fee, in which guests are invited to create their own set of Hanafuda cards, or learn how to play games with the cards.

main.title: Silent Hill 2
main.summary: Silent Hill 2 is a 2024 survival horror game developed by Bloober Team and published by Konami Digital Entertainment.

cards.heading: A letter draws James back to Silent Hill
cards.text: Silent Hill 2 is a 2024 survival horror game developed by Bloober Team and published by Konami Digital Entertainment. It is a remake of the 2001 video game Silent Hill 2, originally developed by Team Silent, a group within Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo (KCET). It is the first major installment in the Silent Hill series since Silent Hill: Downpour (2012). Like the original game, it follows James Sunderland, a widower, who returns to the eponymous town in Maine upon receiving a letter from his deceased wife, Mary, who claims to be waiting there for him.

cards.heading: Rebuilding the town with its original artists
cards.text: The remake of Silent Hill 2 was officially announced in October 2022, following months of speculation and leaks. It was led by Bloober Team creative director Mateusz Lenart and produced by Motoi Okamoto from Konami. Masahiro Ito and Akira Yamaoka, who served as creature designer and composer for the original game, respectively, took an active part in development. According to Maciej Głomb, Ito provided concept art for locations and monsters while Yamaoka returned as a composer.

cards.heading: Release, reception and later platforms
cards.text: Silent Hill 2 was released for PlayStation 5 and Windows on October 8, 2024, and later released on Xbox Series X/S on November 21, 2025. The game has received generally positive reviews from critics, who praised its story, graphics, atmospheric setting, performances and faithfulness to the source material. It had sold over 2.5 million units by October 2025, and earned several awards, including nominations at the British Academy Games Awards, the Golden Joystick Awards, and the Game Awards.

main.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
main.summary: Metaphor: ReFantazio is a 2024 role-playing video game developed by Studio Zero and published by Sega.

cards.heading: Studio Zero builds a new fantasy
cards.text: Metaphor: ReFantazio is a 2024 role-playing video game developed by Studio Zero and published by Sega. Metaphor: ReFantazio was first announced under the working title Project Re:Fantasy in December 2016, with no further information revealed until 2023, and was released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S by Atlus in Japan and by Sega internationally on October 11, 2024. A Nintendo Switch 2 version will be released on November 12, 2026.

cards.heading: A royal tournament across Euchronia
cards.text: The game is set in the United Kingdom of Euchronia, a medieval fantasy realm mirroring the contemporary real world, after the assassination of its former King. Years earlier, an assassination attempt on the Prince resulted in him being cursed and falling into a long slumber. The protagonist, an orphaned boy of the magic-wielding Elda tribe and the Prince's childhood friend, participates in the Royal Tournament held to decide the throne's successor, journeying across Euchronia to rally support from its people while searching for a way to lift the curse.

cards.heading: Launch figures and major awards
cards.text: Metaphor: ReFantazio reached one million units in physical shipments and digital sales on release day across all platforms and received widespread acclaim, with praise being directed towards its narrative, worldbuilding, visuals, gameplay, and themes reflecting real-world issues both politically and socially, although it received some criticism regarding its technical problems at launch. It was nominated for several awards, including Game of the Year from several outlets and awards ceremonies, and won the Game Awards for Best Art Direction, Best Narrative, and Best Role-Playing Game, won the D.I.C.E. Award for Role-Playing Game of the Year at the 28th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards, and won the Grand Prize at the 2025 Japan Game Awards.

main.title: Super Mario Party Jamboree
main.subtitle: A larger gathering at the Party Plaza
main.summary: Super Mario Party Jamboree is Nintendo Cube's Switch party game, released on 17 October 2024.

cards.heading: A larger gathering at the Party Plaza
cards.text: Super Mario Party Jamboree is Nintendo Cube's Switch party game, released on 17 October 2024. A large collection of boards and activities gathers Mario's cast around the Party Plaza, combining the usual race for Stars with cooperative and competitive alternatives. The main board game keeps players moving independently through changing routes and events. Its broader selection makes choosing the activity part of hosting the gathering: the same group can settle into a board match or move towards something shorter and more directly physical.

cards.heading: Win a companion for the next few turns
cards.text: Jamboree Buddies appear during board matches and trigger a minigame that decides who gains their help. A buddy lasts for several turns, can double a space's effect and provides an ability tied to the character. Winning that companion therefore changes the value of a later destination as well as the current contest. Pro Rules offer a more controlled competitive arrangement, while motion-controlled minigames can be excluded from ordinary board play. The options let a group adjust how much uncertainty or physical input belongs in its match.

cards.heading: Another way to arrange the same group
cards.text: Other activities turn the Joy-Con towards rhythmic cooking, cooperative machinery puzzles and imitated flight. Party Planner Trek gives a solo player missions across the boards, and online modes expand some competitions to larger groups. Shigenobu Okawa and Yuta Yamaguchi composed the music. The original Switch version establishes the collection, with an expanded Switch 2 edition following in 2025. Jamboree develops the party as a set of possible arrangements, keeping the recognizable board contest at its center while giving the same cast and controllers several other reasons to gather.

main.title: Batman: Arkham Shadow
main.summary: Batman: Arkham Shadow is a 2024 action-adventure game developed by Camouflaj and published by Oculus Studios.

cards.heading: A younger Batman confronts the Rat King
cards.text: Batman: Arkham Shadow is a 2024 action-adventure game developed by Camouflaj and published by Oculus Studios. It is the second virtual reality game in the Batman: Arkham series (following Batman: Arkham VR) and a narrative sequel to Batman: Arkham Origins and Batman: Arkham Origins Blackgate (2013). Set six months after the events of Arkham Origins, the game follows a younger and less experienced Batman, who attempts to stop a mysterious villain called the Rat King from destroying Gotham City on the Fourth of July. It also depicts Batman's transition from a violent and vengeful vigilante into a symbol of hope, and explores the evolution of Bruce Wayne's relationship with his childhood friend, Harvey Dent, as well as the events that led to Dent's transformation into the duality-obsessed criminal, Two-Face.

cards.heading: An Arkham adventure made for VR
cards.text: Arkham Shadow was released for the Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3S on October 22, 2024, to critical acclaim.

main.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
main.summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 is a 2024 first-person shooter video game co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software and published by Activision.

cards.heading: A rogue CIA team during Desert Storm
cards.text: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 is a 2024 first-person shooter video game co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software and published by Activision. It is the twenty-first main installment of the Call of Duty series and is the seventh entry in the Black Ops sub-series, following Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War (2020). Set during Operation Desert Storm, Black Ops 6's single-player story follows rogue CIA operatives Troy Marshall and Frank Woods as they assemble a team of agents to hunt down Pantheon, a paramilitary group with covert ties to the agency. As with previous Call of Duty titles, the game also includes a multiplayer component and a new iteration of the cooperative round-based Zombies mode.

cards.heading: Four years of development and Omnimovement
cards.text: Black Ops 6 had a four-year development cycle—the longest in Call of Duty history; a portion of the game's production was spent on rebuilding core aspects of Black Ops within the latest version of the Call of Duty game engine. An omnidirectional movement system was also introduced, allowing players to sprint, dive, and slide in any direction. Marketing for Black Ops 6 began in May 2024, through the release of live-action teaser trailers and the publishing of advertisements on the front pages of multiple newspaper outlets; a full reveal debuted during the 2024 Xbox Games Showcase event on June 9. The game was released on October 25, 2024, for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S.

cards.heading: Reception and the next Black Ops
cards.text: Upon release, Black Ops 6 received generally favorable reviews from critics, achieved the largest launch weekend in the franchise's history, and was nominated for several accolades. All three modes were met with praise, with critics positively highlighting the new omnidirectional movement system. A sequel, titled Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, was released in November 2025.

cards.heading: Requiem returns in round-based Zombies
cards.text: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Zombies is a 2024 cooperative video game developed by Treyarch and published by Activision. Set in February 1991, the game's story follows the senior staff members of the former CIA group "Requiem" directly after the events of Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War (2020). It was released as part of Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 on October 25, 2024, for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S.

cards.heading: Hordes, quests and six main maps
cards.text: As with most previous iterations of Call of Duty's Zombies mode, Black Ops 6 Zombies—playable from either a first-person or third-person perspective—tasks players with combating endless hordes of zombies that increase in both number and difficulty with every round. The mode features six main maps, each of which features a main quest for players to pursue, along with a number of side quests and Easter eggs. Like the core game, it features an omnidirectional movement system, allowing players to sprint, dive, and slide in any direction.

cards.heading: Refining Zombies for veterans and newcomers
cards.text: While developing Black Ops 6 Zombies, Treyarch sought to refine what they established with Black Ops Cold War, introduce new elements to the mode, re-add old aspects from previous games, and make it more approachable for new players. Marketing for the mode began in June 2024 during the 2024 Xbox Games Showcase event; a full reveal debuted in August. Upon release, Black Ops 6 Zombies received positive reviews from critics, who praised its core gameplay format, movement system, and its launch maps. A continuation of its story is featured in the Zombies mode for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 (2025).

main.title: Dragon Age: The Veilguard
main.subtitle: A new Dragon Age adventure in Thedas
main.summary: Dragon Age: The Veilguard is a 2024 action role-playing game developed by BioWare and published by Electronic Arts (EA).

cards.heading: A new Dragon Age adventure in Thedas
cards.text: Dragon Age: The Veilguard is a 2024 action role-playing game developed by BioWare and published by Electronic Arts (EA). It is the fourth major game in the Dragon Age franchise, and the sequel to Dragon Age: Inquisition (2014).

cards.heading: Creating Rook and choosing a background
cards.text: During character creation, the player can choose a lineage for their player character (human, dwarf, elf, or qunari), a fighting class (rogue, mage, or warrior), and a character backstory with one of six faction associations. As with the choice of origin in the original game, the faction association sets the character's course throughout the game. Unlike in previous games, customization options include body size and body part selections that are independent of the voice or pronouns (she/her, he/him, or they/them) chosen for the player character. Players are able to remake their player character from Dragon Age: Inquisition which appears in the game, alongside some other previous Dragon Age characters.

cards.heading: Companions, relationships and real-time battles
cards.text: There are seven companion characters from which two can be chosen to form a combat party of three. Unlike previous games in the series, players cannot directly control the companions in combat. The companions in Veilguard are described as pansexual, allowing romances with player characters of any gender; but Busche said that they were not "playersexual", or only attracted to the player character. Busche also noted that while player decisions can impact relationships with companions, the developers "built finding forgiveness into those relationship dynamics". Increasing the bond between Rook and a companion allows the companion to "grow more powerful". While the combat system is now real-time action-based, as opposed to the tactical–strategy approach of earlier Dragon Age titles, Veilguard still employs a pause-and-play mechanism similar to Inquisition's. Instead of that game's open world design, Veilguard uses a "hub-and-spoke design" where players get around the game's world through magical portals; the areas so accessed vary in size.

main.title: Mario & Luigi: Brothership
main.subtitle: Two brothers reconnect a divided world
main.summary: Mario & Luigi: Brothership is Acquire's role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 7 November 2024.

cards.heading: Two brothers reconnect a divided world
cards.text: Mario & Luigi: Brothership is Acquire's role-playing adventure, released for Nintendo Switch on 7 November 2024. Mario and Luigi arrive in Concordia, a world whose islands have been separated, and set out to reconnect them. The sixth Mario & Luigi game brings the series to a fully three-dimensional home-console setting. Exploration, comic encounters and turn-based fights remain closely linked to the brothers' teamwork, with separate inputs making both characters active participants in crossing the world and confronting its enemies.

cards.heading: Every attack asks for a response
cards.text: In battle, a correctly timed button press strengthens an attack, while watching an enemy's movement helps the brothers jump over or counter an incoming blow. Bros. Attacks turn that coordination into elaborate shared moves. Battle Plugs add effects that can change a chosen approach to an encounter. The player is making tactical choices and performing them at the same time: selecting a move starts a short sequence whose success depends on understanding the action shown on screen.

cards.heading: An island that becomes a ship
cards.text: Shipshape Island serves as a moving base for exploring Concordia's seas. Reaching another island opens quests and puzzles, and reconnecting it expands the network of places and people linked to the ship. Luigi Logic gives Luigi opportunities to act independently or find a solution during a difficult situation. Hideki Sakamoto composed the score. The voyage builds its sense of reunion through this repeated act of reaching an isolated place, helping its inhabitants and making it part of a larger world again.

main.title: Golden Joystick Awards 2024
main.summary: The Golden Joystick Awards, with every category winner of the 2024 edition.

cards.heading: The players' awards
cards.text: The Golden Joystick Awards celebrate games through a public vote, bringing players into the choice of each year's winners. The awards began in Britain with the 1983 season and later reached an international audience through online voting. Their changing categories trace the growth of games: home computers and consoles, handhelds, online play, independent studios, performance and music. Alongside the public vote, special honours recognise individual contributions to the industry. Each edition preserves its own category names, so the results also show what players and the awards organisers considered worth celebrating at the time.

main.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
main.subtitle: A new adventure between two classic films
main.summary: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle is a 2024 action-adventure video game developed by MachineGames and published by Bethesda Softworks.

cards.heading: A new adventure between two classic films
cards.text: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle is a 2024 action-adventure video game developed by MachineGames and published by Bethesda Softworks. It is based on the Indiana Jones franchise and features an original narrative set between the events of Raiders of the Lost Ark (1981) and Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989).

cards.heading: Seeing the world through Indiana Jones
cards.text: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle is an action-adventure game, in which the player assumes control of archaeologist Indiana Jones. The game is primarily played from a first-person perspective, but switches to a third-person view for cutscenes and certain gameplay actions, such as when Jones uses his whip to swing over gaps or when climbing pipes and walls. The player can separately adjust the difficulty of the game's combat and its puzzle-solving and exploration.

cards.heading: Exploring ruins and solving ancient puzzles
cards.text: Larger locations such as the Vatican, Gizeh and Sukhothai offer several routes and optional discoveries. Adventure Books describe permanent improvements, but their benefits must be unlocked with points earned through exploration: photographs, opened safes, relics and notes. A camera also helps with puzzles, providing more hints when a problem is photographed repeatedly. New tools widen the search, including a lighter for dark spaces and a rebreather for underwater routes. Side quests connect people met along the way to the main investigation, giving a detour a purpose beyond filling a collection.

cards.heading: Stealth, improvised weapons and hand-to-hand combat
cards.text: A disguise opens restricted areas until someone recognises Jones or his behaviour exposes him. He can hide bodies, throw objects as distractions or turn a shovel and broom into fragile weapons. The revolver offers another option, but ammunition is scarce. In close combat, blocking, parrying and dodging make space for punches. The whip has more specific uses: striking an arm can disarm someone, while catching their legs brings them down. Fighting, climbing and sprinting consume stamina, so a short rest or food can matter as much as the weapon chosen before entering a guarded room.
